sample_essay:
The use of PowerPoint is becoming increasingly popular in class. This phenomenon has both advantages and disadvantages.

To begin with, using PPT in class can enhance the teaching efficiency. Teachers can present a large amount of information in a short time, such as pictures, videos and texts, which makes the class more vivid and interesting. For example, in a history class, a PPT with historical pictures can help students better understand the past events. In addition, PPT can save time on writing on the blackboard, allowing teachers to focus more on explaining the content.

However, there are also some drawbacks. Some teachers may rely too much on PPT and read the content directly, which reduces the interaction between teachers and students. Moreover, the over-use of flashy effects in PPT may distract students' attention.

In conclusion, while PPT is a useful tool in class, teachers should use it properly, combining it with traditional teaching methods to achieve better teaching results.
